item.title: Newly created dropped kerbway, 19th November
item.description:
I am keen to know if permission was granted for this dropped kerbway to be created on Alstone Croft. This is a residential street and from what I can tell has been done to enable a large van to be parked on the driveway. Street parking has been a problem on Alstone Croft for the seven years I’ve lived there and effectively this driveway reduces the amount that is available. Certainly no consultation was done and I would have opposed it. Can you confirm if this work was done with GCC permission and if it was not can it be undone? Many thanks for you help and time and I look forward to your response. Ben

Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 40, Alstone Croft, Kingsditch, Cheltenham, Cheltenham

item.title: Pedestrian crossing temperamental, 19th November
item.description:
Problem only exists on the crossing from College Road to London Road. Click the button, registers, cars are driving, then when cars stop then red line round the button goes off. Then the next set of cars go to green. So you wait, recline the button which registers, wait for the traffic lights to change again and no green man to cross! You pray someone clicks the button on one of the other sections!
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 1a, London Road, Ewens Farm, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
